claim: In the second quarter of fiscal 2026, Cisco recorded roughly $3.6B of net income.
summary: The claim asserts Cisco's Q2 FY2026 net income was roughly $3.6B. That quarter ends late January 2026 and would be reported after the 2026-01-04 knowledge cutoff, so it cannot be verified from existing knowledge alone.

sub_claims.text: Cisco recorded roughly $3.6B of net income in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
sub_claims.note: Knowledge cutoff is 2026-01-04, before Cisco's Q2 FY2026 period ending late January 2026 was reported in February 2026. No verified net income figure can be established from existing knowledge alone without external sources.
